_why: The set of gate reports a COMPLETE release run must produce. A gate that FAILS or is SKIPPED is loud; a gate REMOVED from release-gates.yml left no trace at all -- the bundle showed eight gates before and after, and no reader could tell the set had changed.
_why_declared_not_derived: The mapping from workflow job to gate name is not 1:1. The session job alone emits two reports (session-cycle and graph-replay-equality), and job names differ from gate names (shacl -> shacl-validation). A name-based derivation would be wrong in a way that is hard to notice.
_on_change: Adding a gate: list it here in the same commit, or the run records it as unexpected. REMOVING a gate: delete it here deliberately -- the diff is then the record that the release decision covers less than it did.
